ordinary.verse: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God.
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid.
Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer.
Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith.
Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks.
What doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy.
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord.
Let your light so shine before men.
If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God.
Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing.
O taste and see that the Lord is good.
Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness.
I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness.
Put on the whole armour of God.
I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
If thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart.
Charity suffereth long, and is kind.
Lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world.
The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
But God commendeth his love toward us.
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee.
For with God nothing shall be impossible.
If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting.
I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above.
Nothing shall be able to separate us from the love of God.
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find.
I am the vine, ye are the branches.
Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
This is the day which the Lord hath made.
For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways.
With God all things are possible.
Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace.
I am the bread of life.
In thy presence is fulness of joy.
For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ.
When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee.
Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart.
I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
I am the resurrection, and the life.
For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God.
My grace is sufficient for thee.
The heavens declare the glory of God.
Ye are the light of the world.
Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid.
I am the way, the truth, and the life.
There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus.
Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.
Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith.
Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee.
Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God.
And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given.
And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
For the Lord God is a sun and shield.
That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee.
Blessed are all they that wait for him.
A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another.
Be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.
Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
For by grace are ye saved through faith.
And the Lord shall guide thee continually.
Man shall not live by bread alone.
Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
Whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
Love worketh no ill to his neighbour.
God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
He is not here: for he is risen.
My kindness shall not depart from thee.
The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined unto me.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God.
The sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory.
O come, let us sing unto the Lord.
For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me.
He must increase, but I must decrease.
The God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly.
Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity.
Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee.
Ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God!
Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord.
Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me.
Here am I; send me.
And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.
I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

lent.verse: Turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping.
Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
Create in me a clean heart, O God.
Is not this the fast that I have chosen?
If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily.
Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.
Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts.
The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart.
Present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God.
Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity?
For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities.
For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive.
Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow.
God be merciful to me a sinner.
But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves.
Yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead.
Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.
Shew me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.
He giveth power to the faint.
For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world.
The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger.
The Spirit also helpeth our infirmities.
Enter ye in at the strait gate.
In returning and rest shall ye be saved.
I acknowledged my sin unto thee.
Joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth.
Let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us.

holyweek.verse: But he was wounded for our transgressions.
Hosanna to the Son of David.
Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit.
He humbled himself, and became obedient unto death.
Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
For this is my blood of the new testament.
Not my will, but thine, be done.
Truly this man was the Son of God.
I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
Greater love hath no man than this.
Truly this was the Son of God.
This is my body which is given for you.
Ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many.

easter.verse: He is not here: for he is risen.
I am the resurrection, and the life.
But now is Christ risen from the dead.
Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more.
The Lord is risen indeed.
Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death.
Blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
The Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you.
Begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection.
With great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection.
Seek those things which are above.
Jesus saith unto her, Mary.
Why seek ye the living among the dead?
Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again.
Lo, I am with you alway.
Him God raised up the third day.
Because I live, ye shall live also.
Who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light.
I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore.
Thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
We shall be saved by his life.
Did not our heart burn within us?
But God raised him from the dead.
Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee.
Go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead.
Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen.
Then went in also that other disciple, and he saw, and believed.
Like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father.

pentecost.verse: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost.
Ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you.
The Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, shall teach you all things.
For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh.
Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
When he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth.
Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing.

advent.verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given.
Out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel.
Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son.
Thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son.
Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son.
The dayspring from on high hath visited us.
That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness.
I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait.
Prepare ye the way of the Lord.
Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
Make his paths straight.
There shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse.
My soul doth magnify the Lord.
When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us.
Arise, shine; for thy light is come.
Mine eyes have seen thy salvation.
In him shall the Gentiles trust.

christmas.verse: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour.
And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us.
When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace.
The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light.
She brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes.
Thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God.
Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
They presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
That holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
God sent forth his Son, made of a woman.
I am the light of the world.
Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth.

epiphany.verse: They saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him.
And the Gentiles shall come to thy light.
Where is he that is born King of the Jews?
That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
A light to lighten the Gentiles.
I will give thee for a light of the Gentiles.
Ye are the light of the world.
I am come a light into the world.
Yea, all kings shall fall down before him.
The people which sat in darkness saw great light.

leapyear.verse: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
